name: Code Reader
description: Reads and parses Python source code, extracting structure, variable names, and control flow.

name: Test Generator
description: Generates pytest test cases for the given Python function, covering happy path and edge cases.

name: Python Runner
description: Executes Python code snippets in a sandboxed environment and captures stdout, stderr, and exit codes.

name: Failure Analyzer
description: Analyzes test failures, stack traces, and error messages to identify root causes.

name: Static Analyzer
description: Performs static analysis on Python code checking for type hints, style issues, and common anti-patterns.

name: Patch Suggester
description: Generates corrected code patches for identified bugs and suggests refactoring improvements.
